newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms to 475/476 per dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms to 475/476 per dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar firmed to 475.00/476.00 per dollar as commercial banks sold dollars for bolivars to meet a temporary liquidity squeeze, traders said.
"It was a totally atypical day," said one trader. "Both banks and businesses needed bolivars," he added.

The dollar sales came as banks looked for bolivars outside the overnight interbank market where interest rates have hovered at 40 percent over the past two days. The temporary liquidity squeeze also saw a two percentage point back-up in TEM yields at today's 50 billion bolivar auction.
Traders commented they expected to see the bolivar soften during Thursday's session.
